conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: And so, we arrived at the Boss Room...

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Yes, we were finally able to open the pub we had always dreamed of!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: It is perfect!... but, there’s a slight problem.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: To be honest, I barely managed to create a path connecting the surface and the dungeon by selling the treasures I found...

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: But after that, I ended up completely broke!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: I had to sell the fields where I raised the barleys to decorate the shop.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: After that... my magic friend MALT disappeared.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: I make beer now, but I really wonder where MALT is and what he’s doing.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Without him, I never would have achieved this dream!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Ahhh, my friend! The friend who could have become the greatest beer!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: To honor him, I always tell his heroic tales to the customers who have traveled all the way to this deep place.
